descriptions.d26c_chute_message_800dac50: Id 64: base handler and on success register fields (0x800dae1c), else 0x80004005. Id 66: stop (0x800dafa4) then base handler. Cached ids start (0x800db014), switch off (0x800daffc), start when inactive and clear +76, finish (0x8015fd1c, also on an owner match), set or clear +148 and +152. Other ids go to the base handler. Returns 0 on handled paths.
